_description: Cursor bundle skill-pack catalog. Each shipped skill maps to exactly one pack. `core` installs by default; other packs are explicit (--packs) or --all. Budget: default-install (core skills + the 3 core agents) name+description <= budgetChars. Extended packs are intentionally empty for now (Phase 3 ships core only); a later phase adds development/review/product/operations/integrations/media skills adapted from the codex bundle.

core.description: Always-on lifecycle kernel: orient, plan, implement, test, verify, review, ship, and session/orchestration helpers installed by default.
